description: Run a real live test on one or more proxies: is it alive, which protocols it speaks, its anonymity grade, latency and location. No key. Each check opens a real connection, so a dead proxy can take a few seconds. Up to 25 per call.

proxies.description: Proxies as ip:port, e.g. ['203.0.113.7:1080']. Up to 25.
